blocks.content: Quiz: You want to add a Dark mode toggle that switches the whole page to a dark theme. Which approach fits the patterns from this course?
Tap an option below to answer:
Use a different CSS file for dark mode and switch the link href in JavaScript.
This can work, but it's more moving parts than you need. In this course, we prefer a single class toggle and let CSS handle the theme.
This can work, but it's more moving parts than you need. In this course, we prefer a single class toggle and let CSS handle the theme.
Toggle a class on body (for example, .dark) and define dark theme colors in CSS when body.dark is present.
One click toggles a class. CSS does the styling. This matches the same pattern you used for menus, like buttons, and modals.
One click toggles a class. CSS does the styling. This matches the same pattern you used for menus, like buttons, and modals.
Change every element's style with JavaScript (for example, element.style.background).
This gets messy fast. It's harder to maintain than toggling a class and keeping styles in CSS.
This gets messy fast. It's harder to maintain than toggling a class and keeping styles in CSS.
Reload the page with a query parameter so the server can send dark mode HTML.
That's overkill for a simple theme toggle. You can do it fully on the client with one class.
That's overkill for a simple theme toggle. You can do it fully on the client with one class.
